name: codexworker
description: CodexWorker: exposes Codex Desktop native tasks to Hermes through a local manager bridge.

interface.shortDescription: CodexWorker bridge for Codex Desktop native tasks.
interface.longDescription: Runs inside the Codex Desktop plugin host and verifies access to native task tools before enabling the Hermes manager API. This copy only renames the plugin and adds a CLI entry point.
